mixed.headline: One road. Human and robot drivers.
mixed.title: One junction. A connected city.
mixed.imageAlt: Source presentation diagram of local traffic observations and shared-policy Stop-or-Go control.
mixed.sceneAlt: Future concept: human-driven and robot vehicles, a pedestrian, and traffic signals share a connected street grid.
mixed.description: The current research evaluates local robot-vehicle decisions and intersection configurations in SUMO. Connecting this to a city requires human-response modeling, coordinated signal operations, and real-road evaluation with agencies and vehicle developers. A road grid, vehicles, pedestrian, and traffic signal illustrate the shared system. This diagram is a future concept and does not assert deployment of the studied controller.
